_comment: The running bar at the foot of the home page. Add, remove or reorder items here and rebuild - no code change needed. Keep each one short: it has to be readable as it slides past. 'label' is an optional small tag. Set "kind": "notice" for something a customer is worse off for missing - holiday hours, a stock delay, a price change. Notices show in amber and always come round first. Delete a notice once it stops being true; a stale one costs you the whole bar.
